# Mountain Extreme

> > Dubai's premier climbing gym offering AMGA-certified instruction, youth climbing programs, and comprehensive climbing courses for all ages and skill levels.

Mountain Extreme is located in Al Quoz, Dubai, and features a Climbing Academy with programs ranging from Little Climbers (ages 4-6) to advanced lead climbing courses. The facility emphasizes certified instruction through AMGA and UK Certified Climbing Wall Instructors, with specialized youth programs including GCSE climbing curriculum integration.

## Key Topics

- AMGA (American Mountain Guide Association)
- Climbing Academy
- Youth climbing programs
- Little Climbers Program (ages 4-6)
- Young Climbers Program (ages 7-17)
- Certified Climbing Wall Instructor
- GCSE climbing curriculum
- Lead climbing and belaying
- Rock climbing and bouldering
- Petzl GriGri equipment
- Child safeguarding policies
- Personalized climbing coaching
- EdExcel certification
- Dubai Al Quoz location

## Youth Climbing Programs

- [Little Climbers | Mountain Extreme](https://www.mtnextreme.com/copy-of-beginner): Little Climbers Program for children ages 4-6 with AMGA instructors
- [Junior | Mountain Extreme](https://www.mtnextreme.com/junior-climbers): Junior climbing classes for ages 7-17 with certified instructors
- [Intermediate | Mountain Extreme](https://www.mtnextreme.com/ycp-intermediate): Intermediate climbing course with technique and knowledge awards

## Advanced Training & Courses

- [Lead | Mountain Extreme](https://www.mtnextreme.com/copy-of-1on1): Lead climbing course with belay instruction and safety training
- [1on1 | Mountain Extreme](https://www.mtnextreme.com/copy-of-gcse): Personalized 1-on-1 climbing coaching for skill development
